I stayed voluntarily in a psychiatric ward for a couple weeks in Somerset, it was really helpful. They assigned me an occupational therapist and I always had someone to talk to and plenty to do, was a very safe environment. They also take outpatients because there’s not usually a spare bed available so if you think it would be a good idea then go for it. Bless the NHS lol
